takeaways.title: Pick the connection pattern by who governs what
takeaways.body: Central network team plus app teams in their own projects means Shared VPC (same organization, subnet-level compute.networkUser). Peering is non-transitive and forbids overlapping ranges, so use Private Service Connect for one-way private access to a single service, and Network Connectivity Center for hub-and-spoke across many VPCs and sites.

takeaways.title: A hybrid SLA comes from topology, not product
takeaways.body: 99.99% on Dedicated or Partner Interconnect needs redundant connections or attachments across two metros in separate edge availability domains, two Cloud Routers, and global dynamic routing; a single connection never qualifies. Choose HA VPN (about 1 to 3 Gbps per tunnel) for fast starts and backup, and add MACsec or HA VPN over Interconnect when the private path must also be encrypted.

takeaways.title: Match the load balancer and the control to the requirement
takeaways.body: Worldwide HTTP(S) with one anycast IP, URL routing and CDN is the global external Application LB; preserving client source IP or non-HTTP protocols points to a passthrough Network LB. Use hierarchical firewall policies for org or folder guardrails, Cloud Armor to block at the edge, and Cloud IDS only to detect, because it never blocks.

takeaways.title: Storage compliance is a lock, cost is lifecycle
takeaways.body: WORM or 'nobody can shorten retention' means a retention policy plus Bucket Lock; versioning and soft delete (7 days by default) are safety nets, not compliance. For age-based cost use lifecycle rules (Nearline 30, Coldline 90, Archive 365 days minimum) when the pattern is known and Autoclass when it is not, never both for class changes.

takeaways.title: Size the transfer and the backup by the deadline and the RPO
takeaways.body: If the network needs more than a week, use Transfer Appliance; use Storage Transfer Service for large online or cloud-to-cloud moves and gcloud storage for small ad hoc copies. Centralized, application-consistent backups with immutable vaults mean Backup and DR Service, plus Cloud SQL automated backups and PITR for databases.

takeaways.title: Choose the compute and AI model with the least operations that meets the hard constraint
takeaways.body: Stateless scale-to-zero containers go to Cloud Run, hands-off Kubernetes to GKE Autopilot (Standard only for privileged or node-level needs), unchanged VMware to VMware Engine. Steady baselines get committed use discounts, interruptible batch gets Spot in a MIG, and guaranteed capacity (including scarce accelerators) needs a reservation or Flex-start; for ML, try prebuilt APIs, then Model Garden, then custom training on Pipelines.
